name: flat-water-item-push
comment: Water from a source at (0,61,0) flows into a yellow flower on dirt at (2,61,0): BlockFlowing.flowIntoBlock drops it as an item (Block.dropBlockAsItem, BlockFlowing.java:116-130: World.rand and Math.random() draws), and the EntityItem is pushed by the flow (World.handleMaterialAcceleration -> BlockFluid.velocityToAddToEntity / getFlowVector, BlockFluid.java:98-185). entity_state and rng_state every tick.
